text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day was just around the corner.
The Umamusume around the academy were bustling about, and—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, are you here to consult with Flight too?
If so, please line up over there!

Looking in the direction she pointed...
there is a massive line stretching out
in front of North Flight's classroom!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's basically it.
Man, I'm at my wit's end.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
Let's sort this out then.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So you're going to afternoon tea
at a hotel with Gold City-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: So, you want to dress a little differently from your usual self and surprise City-chan... is that right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm always in loungewear, y'know~?
When it comes to dressing proper, I kinda just have to rely on Lady Flight.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't want City thinking,
"Doesn't she even know TPO?" or whatever.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood.
I'll mobilize all of my knowledge!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
By Valentine's Day, let's come up with
an outfit that'll blow City-chan away!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thank you sooooooooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, lucky Jordan!
I want to get advice soon too~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is right around the corner, right?
With dates and outings and stuff...
How am I supposed to decide what to wear?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whenever anyone consults Flight-san,
she suggests the perfect outfit for them!
Word is, it guarantees a successful Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So then, you...
want to give the chocolate at the observation deck, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, on the actual day each year,
gorgeous decorations are added and photo spots are set up too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Shall we review the concept for this year's exhibit? Keeping in mind that it'll be posted on Umastagram, I want to pick the absolute best color—

North Flight looks like she'll be busy for a while,
guiding the troubled Umamusume.
...I should prepare some snacks to thank her for her hard work.
choice_data_list: (You can do it, everyone... Flight too!)

text_block_list.text: And then came Valentine's Day—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I wanted to stop by here before afternoon tea.
Super cute brand, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, cute.
Never knew that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Looks like this select shop
is the only place that carries it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's pick out clothes together,
and go all out on afternoon tea? Whaddya say?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm, let's do that.
Not bad, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Flight, seriously, thanks a ton!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Now, I wonder how the others are doing?

After school,
I went to check on North Flight...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, everything went well for everyone.
Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes! I was able to see everyone's smiles with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

What I handed to North Flight was
the Valentine's chocolate I had bought in advance.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: I picked this out thinking it would suit you!
I chose something I thought would suit you!

text_block_list.text:
I selected top-quality chocolate while carefully
evaluating the visual appeal and product concept
to pick the absolute best one.
As we continued chatting idly about these things... I suddenly noticed something off about North Flight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah...
Aaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I-I messed up...!
...——

I led the frozen North Flight away to a spot where no one was around.
Once there, she slowly began to speak bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I was thinking... that I would do something for Valentine's this year too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Everyone shines so brightly around this time of year."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There are times when they worry and fret,
but the power of love is strong... and pure.
And oh, the smile on their face after handing it over!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: So I wanted to... spend Valentine's Day in my own way too, and I've been thinking about all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what to wear...
or whether I should make chocolate or buy some... that sort of thing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Still... watching over everyone this year,
the time just flew by before I even realized it.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Still!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Getting chocolates from Trainer made this a truly special Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much!
For your thoughtfulness, and the chocolates...
I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose this kind of Valentine's Day
is very fitting for me, too—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh,
found Flight.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Are you free after this?
Wanna have a Valentine's party in the cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, all of us who were helped out by Flight
got to talking about how we wanted to thank her."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I totally bought chocolates and stuff in bulk!
It'll totally hype us up. Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Looks like this Valentine's Day is going to be extra special.
Looks like this Valentine's Day is going to be extra special!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And so, it seems North Flight enjoyed her
own unique Valentine's Day to the very end.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: So I wanted to... try doing Valentine's Day too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: With Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I think... the moment I can shine brightest is when I give it to you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Because you are always by my side, cheering me on...
and accepting me for who I am."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What outfit should I wear...
Where should I go out to...
What kind of sweets should I make?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What outfit would make Trainer happy?
A place Trainer might like...
Chocolates that suit Trainer—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Even though...
I put so much thought into it..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Even so,
I ended up receiving it from you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy!
Truly, from the bottom of my heart... so very much!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First off,
thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm not mad at all!
I'm just troubled!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Because... I wanted to be the one to give these feelings to Trainer."
choice_data_list: Then let's do it right now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Starting... right now?
choice_data_list: It has to be today, or you wouldn't like it, right?
It has to be today, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.text:
"She thinks of ways to make the most of her ingredients.
Unless it's on Valentine's Day itself, she won't be fully satisfied."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll go put together a special Valentine's
coordinate right away! Yours too, Trainer.”

And so, while North Flight was getting ready,
I hurriedly submitted an overnight pass, and—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Why don't we check out that shop over there?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it looks wonderful on you♪
Your Valentine's outfit!

Dressed in our best Valentine's Day outfits,
North Flight and I headed out together.
